errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies "ИЦН" as "Индекс на човешкото развитие" (Human Development Index). In this economic context, "ИЦН" stands for "Индивидуално крайно потребление" (Actual Individual Consumption - AIC), as indicated by the y-axis label and the common use of this abbreviation in economic charts from the region.

errors.text_span: достигайки в края на периода стойности около 70 за БВП и 72,3 за ИЦН.
errors.evidence: The description states that the line for Latvia ends at approximately GDP 70 and AIC 72.3. This is incorrect. The labeled point is (68.9, 72.3), but the line continues past this point in a loop, with its final endpoint being at approximately GDP 58 and AIC 71. The description misinterprets a labeled point for the end of the series.

errors.text_span: Всички три линии са разположени над черната диагонална линия
errors.evidence: The statement that all three lines are located above the black diagonal line is incorrect. The grey line (Lithuania) clearly starts below the diagonal line before crossing it. The orange line (Latvia) also has points that are on or very close to the diagonal line.

errors.text_span: като това показва, че във всички три държави ИЦН е по-висок от БВП на човек (в ППС) във всички наблюдения.
errors.evidence: The description interprets the position of the lines relative to the diagonal, explaining what it means (AIC is higher than GDP). This is an interpretation that goes beyond a purely objective description of the visual elements, which is forbidden by the prompt.
The line for Latvia starts at a GDP value of approximately 32, not 30. This is a minor inaccuracy.
The line for Estonia starts at an AIC value of approximately 45, not 40. This is a noticeable underestimate.
The line for Lithuania starts at a GDP value of approximately 33, not 30. This is a minor inaccuracy.

errors.text_span: След това се изкачва по-бавно спрямо другите две държави
errors.evidence: The description compares the rate of ascent of the Lithuanian line to the other two lines. The prompt explicitly instructs to avoid comparing the lines.

errors.text_span: В края на периода са посочени конкретни стойности за всеки от трите реда: за Латвия – 68,9 (БВП) и 72,3 (ИЦН); за Естония – 83,2 и 79,6; за Литва – 81,6 и 66,5.
errors.evidence: This final sentence repeats the final or labeled data points for all three countries, information that was already provided (or should have been provided correctly) in the individual paragraphs for each country. This makes the description redundant.

errors.text_span: В областта около БВП 50–60 се наблюдава леко извиване нагоре
errors.evidence: The trajectory for Latvia in the GDP 50-60 range is a complex loop that includes a significant reversal on the x-axis. Describing this as a 'slight upward curve' is a significant over-generalization that misrepresents the line's actual path.
